description: Method to change the ownership of folders and optionally dashboards.

folder_name.description: The target folder whose ownership needs to be changed.

new_owner_name.description: The new owner to whom the folder (and optionally dashboards) ownership will be transferred.

original_owner_rule.description: Specifies the ownership rule to set original owner after changing ownership('edit' or 'view'). Default is 'edit'.

change_dashboard_ownership.description: Specifies whether to also change the ownership of dashboards in the folder tree. Default is True.
